name: qkd_ectl3_kiss_st-e5-COMMIT
purpose: KV-ECTL5 2026-10-19: route qkd_ectl3_kiss_st-e4-13455b5bb NEEDS_HUMAN, DRT-0073 'No access point for u_a/req_t[10]' twice. Cause: the children's abstract pocket closing (tools/hier_contract/abstract_pin_stub.py) kept only ONE routing pitch free beside each pin; its fill rects are wide metal, and ASAP7 M4..M7 need 0.072 um beside a wide shape, so a pin with a fill one pitch away (M6 0.064, M5 0.048) has no DRC-clean access stub: 35 pins on qkd_static_ectla_kiss (req_t[10]/[12], rsp_data[100..]), 4 on qkd_ectl_c_st (s0[33], s1[0], s2[33], s3[0]); the raw exporter LEFs have 0. Fix: keep-out = whole pitches >= the wide spacing (M6 0.128, M5/M4 0.096); child_lint (i) and ref_tile gen refuse a view with such a pin. The children are swapped to the closed rt80 views (A qkd_static_ectla_k4-rt80-2a3a97cb2, B qkd_ectl_b_tp8_direct_rt80-rt80-31faa305d, C qkd_ectl_c_st_rt80-rt80-97adfb584) as e4 required; A and C abstracts re-finalized from their preserved raw export (export_provenance.finalize, same pins/outline, only fill OBS changed; B already clean). Parent geometry (outline, child origins, pin plan) unchanged. | KV-ECTL4 2026-10-18 (coordinator 0gs (d)): the die binds this frame #(.RESPONSE_LAT(80), .QK_ISSUE_AGE(91)) (one K round trip for all 32 frames, kv_k_rt_eq request-chain pads; QK = RL + 11 is the exact minimum: QK 90 fails SRAM row mismatch, bench_witness_ectl4/k_rule_qk90.log) and grants the 725.76 x 261.36 slot (kv_die OT_KV_ECTL_ST_FRAME, kit pins). The children must be the views re-hardened at those values: A qkd_static_ectla_k4 (RESPONSE_LAT 80 / QK 91), B qkd_ectl_b_tp8_direct_rt80, C qkd_ectl_c_st_rt80 (ROW_RETURN_LAT 87 / QK 91): same outlines and pin plans as k3 / pg16 / c_st, so this gate (on the k3 / pg16 / c_st views) is the frame geometry; swap the children views to the rt80 views when they close. |

structural_change: S-KVASTK 2026-10-18: the static ECTL frame qkd_ectl3_kiss_st (die master qkd_ectlk x32) hardened as a WIRES-ONLY cluster of its three CLOSED views: A qkd_static_ectla_kiss (qkd_static_ectla_k3-r3-828d82516, CRITICAL), B qkd_ectl_b_tp8_direct (pg16 view: STATIC_QK 1 / RRL 21 / HXK 13 = the frame's die parameters; the base kit view is at the module defaults STATIC_QK 0 / RRL 9 / HXK 0 and would be functionally wrong here), C qkd_ectl_c_st (qkd_ectl_c_st-v1-f88e1e2c0). Children bottom-aligned on the 43.2 lattice (A x 43.2, B x 259.2, C x 561.6; y 43.2) so A.rs_o / B.rs_i and B.x_i / C.x_b keep their grant y (straight 43-um seams); C.x_a -> A.x_i (52 b) crosses B on M6. No parent logic (assign-only concatenation of t0 / t1), so no std-cell band. Exact io_tcl: every frame pin is the straight projection of its child pin (C's t0_q / t1_q / si / so runs spread in bit order to <= 5.3/um). Clock: three ENTRIES ck[0..2] on the N face straight above each child's ck pin (die delivers phi - R_i per entry; no parent tree). RTL: `ifndef KVD_ECTLK_HARD keeps the parameter overrides for simulation; the hard path instantiates the views without overrides (textbook_lint hard_child_params).
